labs.title: Broken Access Control
labs.description: Learn how authorization flaws allow unauthorized users to view, tamper with, or delete sensitive data.

labs.title: Security Misconfiguration
labs.description: Investigate default credentials, exposed debug interfaces, and unauthenticated directory listings leaking sensitive backups.

labs.title: Software Supply Chain Failures
labs.description: Understand risks from unverified third-party dependencies, malicious package scripts, and vulnerable build artifacts.

labs.title: Cryptographic Failures
labs.description: Explore the risks of legacy broken hashes (MD5), hardcoded encryption keys, and sensitive data leakage.

labs.title: Injection
labs.description: Understand SQL injection root causes, malicious query manipulation, and parameterized query remediation.

labs.title: Insecure Design
labs.description: Analyze flawed business logic, unverified workflow state transitions, and missing architectural security controls.

labs.title: Authentication Failures
labs.description: Explore how weak credential requirements, lack of brute-force protection, and session fixation lead to account takeover.

labs.title: Software or Data Integrity Failures
labs.description: Understand vulnerabilities from accepting unverified, untrusted software or configuration artifacts without cryptographic signatures.

labs.title: Security Logging & Alerting Failures
labs.description: Discover how insufficient security telemetry, missing audit trails, and silent failures prevent incident detection.

labs.title: Mishandling of Exceptional Conditions
labs.description: Examine dangerous fail-open exception handling where upstream service errors accidentally bypass authorization boundaries.
